currentActivation: Disabled until server-side configuration and merchant test checkout are completed.
implementation: Server-authoritative prices and Razorpay plan validation
Authenticated and same-origin checkout, verification, refresh and cancellation
Raw-body HMAC webhook verification and event deduplication
Provider readback of subscription, invoice and captured payment
Paid period ledger isolated by test/live mode, revocation for refunds and disputes
Atomic per-account usage shared across linked workspaces and retained after conversation deletion
Shared chat and report-followup quota; each workflow step consumes one report run
No rollover or automatic overage charges; saved reports remain readable after expiry
activationSteps: Save TEST keys in ignored .env.billing.local; do not paste secrets into chat.
Run node scripts/setup-razorpay.mjs to create or validate the four approved TEST plans and prepare a webhook secret.
In Razorpay TEST mode, create a webhook at the endpoint below using the secret from the ignored file; subscribe to the listed events.
Install settings as server-side Sites secrets using native environment tools. Do not put them in .openai/hosting.json or client source.
Publish test mode, complete merchant test checkout in both currencies, verify webhook delivery and cancellation. No real cards or money are needed.
Before live activation, configure separate LIVE keys, LIVE plan IDs and LIVE webhook secret; confirm commercial terms/tax treatment and support details with the operator.
Enable BILLING_MODE=live only after test acceptance. International payments and Subscriptions were reported enabled by the operator, not independently inspected.

policies.counting: Started, stopped, partial and retried runs count. Duplicate chat request IDs do not count again.
policies.cancellation: Cancel future renewal; retain independently verified paid period until expiry.
policies.refunds: Operator reviews requests; a refunded or disputed period is suspended for review.
policies.planChanges: First release requires cancellation and paid-period expiry before subscribing to another plan/currency.
policies.evaluationDuringSetup: Existing daily evaluation limits remain while billing mode is disabled or test.
policies.evaluationAfterLiveActivation: Three report runs and ten chat questions total; expired paid accounts do not reset to evaluation.
policies.unknownCheckoutResult: A timeout or uncertain create response leaves an account lock. Reconcile provider subscriptions against signalforge_account notes before releasing it; never blindly retry a POST.

rollback: Set BILLING_MODE=disabled and redeploy to pause new checkout and return to evaluation behavior. This does not cancel existing provider mandates: cancel those in Razorpay if required. Preserve all five billing tables and historical usage. Applied migrations are immutable.
limitations: No automatic plan upgrades or prorations
No automated refunds or tax-invoice implementation
No independent live merchant checkout test yet
